headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Veterans Affairs if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials at the Department of Veterans Affairs would step in to act as Secretary if the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are absent or unable to do the job. Orders like this help make sure someone is always in charge. No abstract was provided, so details such as the specific positions named are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Veterans Affairs
who_it_affects.how: Some of them could be called on to temporarily lead the department if top leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on August 12, 2016 (not confirmed by the source material)
